label: Theme File Path
description: Path to the zen-browser.css theme file

label: Enable Transparent Zen
description: Uses surface color with transparency for background, disables website theming.

label: Enable Website Boost
description: Applies the selected color boost to every website. Disable to leave websites untouched.

label: Boost Color
description: Which scheme variable is used for the website boost

label: Color Intensity (0-200, higher = more vivid)
description: Saturation multiplier. Range 0-200, default 150. Lower = more muted, higher = more vivid.

label: Color Brightness (0-100, higher = brighter)
description: Brightness. Range 0-100, default 15. Lower = darker, higher = brighter.

label: Color Strength (0-100, lower = stronger)
description: Tint opacity. Range 0-100, default 30. Lower = stronger tint, higher = more subtle.
